notes: Eclipse Loop 2.3.0 128 arranger tracks, alternate arrangements in one project, multi-sample pads, control-surface support, three new piano-roll verbs, LFO automation, and a pile of things that were quietly half-wired. The big ones 128 arranger tracks, up from 32. The SEQ view is unchanged — it still shows the tracks you have added; + Add Track simply no longer stops at 32. Alternate arrangements in one project. The ARR button in the arranger toolbar holds the list, plus New, Duplicate, Rename and Delete. Arrangements share your tracks and mixer and swap only the clips, markers, tempo map and automation — a different song built from the same channels, not a second project. Switching clears the undo history on purpose: undo stores whole-arrangement snapshots, so undoing after a switch would push the previous arrangement's clips into the one you just opened. Deleting asks first, because that one cannot be undone. Remove a SEQ track. Right-click a track ▸ Remove track. The rows below move up and the track's sample, its steps in every pattern, channel FX, sends and plugin go with it
